name: Stripe Payments
description: Hosted Stripe Checkout, signed webhook verification, refunds, expiration and reconciliation through the Artio payment provider contract.

stripeSecretKey.label: Stripe secret key
stripeSecretKey.description: Use a restricted Stripe API key with checkout session, payment intent, and refund permissions.

webhookSecret.label: Webhook signing secret
webhookSecret.description: Signing secret for the configured checkout.session webhook endpoint.

testMode.label: Use Stripe test mode
testMode.description: Defaults to test mode. Live secret keys are rejected until this is explicitly disabled.

allowedPaymentMethods.label: Allowed payment method filter
allowedPaymentMethods.description: Optional Stripe dynamic-method allowlist, for example ["twint"]. Leave empty to use Stripe account settings.
